claims.value: Side B: Höpfner lists Barclay’s rear guard by regiments and gives five fresh battalions under Dolgoruki sent forward by Bennigsen at Hof; no simultaneous people total is stated.
claims.rationale: Sequential and possibly overlapping observations; no sum with Bodart’s 7,000. English rendering (ours): "The general had under his command the Kostroma musketeers,1st,3rd and 20th Jäger regiments, Isum and Olwiopol hussars, a battalion of the Polish cavalry regiment, a horse battery and two Cossack regiments." English rendering (ours): "At Hof Barclay met five fresh battalions under Prince Dolgoruki whom Bennigsen had sent forward to receive the rear guard."

citations.quote: Der General hatte unter seinem Befehl: das Kostromasche Musketier-, das 1., 3. und 20. Jäger-Regiment, die Isumschen und Olwiopolschen Husaren, 1 Bat. des Polnischen Reiter-Regiments, 1 reit. Batterie und 2 Kosaken-Regimenter.
Bei Hoff stieß der General Barclay auf 5 frische Bataillone unter dem Fürsten Dolgoruki, den der General Bennigsen zur Aufnahme vorgesandt hatte.

claims.value: Barclay received an order to hold before Hof so that the main army would not be drawn into a general engagement. Bennigsen sent Dolgoruki’s support.
claims.rationale: English rendering (ours): "Before Hof he received the order to halt and hold there so the army, which had sent its heavy guns ahead to Eylau, would not become involved in a general engagement." English rendering (ours): "At Hof Barclay met five fresh battalions under Dolgoruki, sent forward by Bennigsen."
